          Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"dice_count\", count);\n            res.put(\"sides\", sides);\n            res.put(\"modifier\", modifier);\n            res.put(\"min\", count + modifier);\n            res.put(\"max\", count * sides + modifier);\n            res.put(\"average\", count * (sides + 1) / 2.0 + modifier);\n            sendResponse(exchange, 200, toJson(res));\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void handleAbilityCheck(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 405, sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            String body = readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = parseJsonObject(body);\n            List<Object> partyList = (List<Object>) req.get(\"party\");\n            List<Object> monstersList = (List<Object>) req.get(\"monsters\");\n            if (partyList == null || monstersList == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing fields\");\n\n            int baseXp = 0;\n            int monsterCount = 0;\n            for (Object monsterObj : monstersList) {\n                Map<String, Object> monster = (Map<String, Object>) monsterObj;\n                String cr = (String) monster.get(\"cr\");\n                int count = toInt(monster.get(\"count\"));\n                Integer xp = CR_XP.get(cr);\n                if (xp == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Unsupported CR: \" + cr);\n                baseXp += xp * count;\n                monsterCount += count;\n            }\n\n            double multiplier;\n            if (monsterCount == 1) multiplier = 1;\n            else if (monsterCount == 2) multiplier = 1.5;\n            else if (monsterCount <= 6) multiplier = 2;\n            else if (monsterCount <= 10) multiplier = 2.5;\n            else if (monsterCount <= 14) multiplier = 3;\n            else multiplier = 4;\n\n            long adjustedXp = Math.round(baseXp * multiplier);\n\n            int easy = 0, medium = 0, hard = 0, deadly = 0;\n            for (Object memberObj : partyList) {\n                Map<String, Object> member = (Map<String, Object>) memberObj;\n                int level = toInt(member.get(\"level\"));\n                int[] thresholds = LEVEL_THRESHOLDS.get(level);\n                if (thresholds == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Unsupported level: \" + level);\n                easy += thresholds[0];\n                medium += thresholds[1];\n                hard += thresholds[2];\n                deadly += thresholds[3];\n            }\n\n            String difficulty;\n            if (adjustedXp >= deadly) difficulty = \"deadly\";\n            else if (adjustedXp >= hard) difficulty = \"hard\";\n            else if (adjustedXp >= medium) difficulty = \"medium\";\n            else if (adjustedXp >= easy) difficulty = \"easy\";\n            else difficulty = \"trivial\";\n\n            Map<String, Object> thresholds = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            thresholds.put(\"easy\", easy);\n            thresholds.put(\"medium\", medium);\n            thresholds.put(\"hard\", hard);\n            thresholds.put(\"deadly\", deadly);\n\n            Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            res.put(\"base_xp\", baseXp);\n            res.put(\"monster_count\", monsterCount);\n            res.put(\"multiplier\", multiplier);\n            res.put(\"adjusted_xp\", adjustedXp);\n            res.put(\"difficulty\", difficulty);\n            res.put(\"thresholds\", thresholds);\n            sendResponse(exchange, 200, toJson(res));\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void handleInitiative(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if static void handleCombatSessionCreate(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            String body = readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String, Object> req = parseJsonObject(body);\n            String id = (String) req.get(\"id\");\n            if (id == null || id.isEmpty()) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing id\");\n            List<Object> combatantsList = (List<Object>) req.get(\"combatants\");\n            if (combatantsList == null || combatantsList.isEmpty()) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing combatants\");\n            if {\n                Map<String, Object> combatant = (Map<String, Object>) combatantObj;\n                String name = (String) combatant.get(\"name\");\n                if (name == null ||       int score = roll + dex;\n                combatants.add(new Combatant(name, score, dex));\n            }\n\n            combatants.sort((a, b) -> {\n                if (b.score != a.score) 1);\n            res.put(\"turn_index\", 0);\n            res.put(\"active\", combatantJson(combatants.get(0)));\n            List<Map<String, Object>> order = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        String path = sendResponse(exchange, 404, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Not found\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        String id = rest.substring(0, slash);\n        String action = rest.substring(slash + 1);\n        CombatSession session = SESSIONS.get(id);\n        if (session == null) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 404, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Session not found\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            if (\"conditions\".equals(action)) {\n                String body = readBody(exchange);\n                Map<String, Object> req = parseJsonObject(body);\n                String target = (String) req.get(\"target\");\n                String condition = (String) req.get(\"condition\");\n                int durationRounds = toInt(req.get(\"duration_rounds\"));\n                if (target == null || condition == null) throw new RuntimeException(\"Missing fields\");\n                if (durationRounds <= 0) throw new RuntimeException(\"Invalid duration\");\n\n                boolean found = false;\n                for (Combatant c : session.order) {\n                    if (c.name.equals(target)) {\n                        found = true;\n LinkedHashMap<>();\n                    condJson.put(\"condition\", cond.condition);\n                    condJson.put(\"remaining_rounds\", cond.remainingRounds);\n                    conditions.add(condJson);\n                }\n                res.put(\"conditions\", conditions);\n                sendResponse(exchange, 200, toJson(res));\n            } else if (\"advance\".equals(action)) {\n                session.turnIndex++;\n                if (session.turnIndex >= session.order.size()) {\n                    session.turnIndex = 0;\n                    session.round++;\n                }\n                Combatant active = session.order.get(session.turnIndex);\n\n                List<Condition> activeConditions = (it.hasNext()) {\n                        Condition cond = it.next();\n                        cond.remainingRounds--;\n                        if (cond.remainingRounds <= 0) it.remove();\n                    }\n                }\n\n                Map<String, Object> res = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                res.put(\"id\", session.id);\n                res.put(\"round\", session.round);\n                res.put(\"turn_index\", session.turnIndex);\n                res.put(\"active\", combatantJson(active));\n                Map<String, Object> conditions = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                for (Map.Entry<String, List<Condition>> entry : session.conditions.entrySet()) {\n                    List<Map<String, Object>> condList = new ArrayList<>();\n                    for (Condition cond : entry.getValue()) {\n                        Map<String, Object> condJson = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n                        condJson.put(\"condition\", cond.condition);\n                        condJson.put(\"remaining_rounds\", cond.remainingRounds);\n                        condList.add(condJson);\n                    }\n                    conditions.put(entry.getKey(), condList);\n                }\n                res.put(\"conditions\", conditions);\n                sendResponse(exchange, 200, toJson(res));\n            } else {\n                sendResponse(exchange, 404, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Not found\\\"}\");\n            }\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void handleRegister(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        if (!\"POST\".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 405, sendResponse(exchange, 405, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Method not allowed\\\"}\");\n            return;\n        }\n        try {\n            String body = readBody(exchange);\n            Map<String,     } catch (RuntimeException e) {\n            sendResponse(exchange, 400, \"{\\\"error\\\":\\\"Invalid request\\\"}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> private static String hashPassword(String password, String salt) {\n        try {\n            SecretKeyFactory factory = SecretKeyFactory.getInstance(\"PBKDF2WithHmacSHA256\");\n            byte[] saltBytes = Base64.getDecoder().decode(salt);\n            KeySpec spec = new PBEKeySpec(password.toCharArray(), saltBytes, 65536, 256);\n            SecretKey key = factory.generateSecret(spec);\n            return Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(key.getEncoded());\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            throw new RuntimeException(e);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static String generateSalt() {\n        byte[] salt = new byte[16];\n        RANDOM.nextBytes(salt);\n        return Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(salt);\n    }\n\n    private static String readBody(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {\n        InputStream is = exchange.getRequestBody();\n        ByteArrayOutputStream baos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();\n        byte[] buffer = new byte[1024];\n        int n;\n        while ((n = is.read(buffer)) >= 0) {\n            baos.write(buffer, 0, n);\n        }\n        return baos.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n    }\n\n    private static void sendResponse(HttpExchange exchange, int status, String body) throws IOException {\n        byte[] bytes = body.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n
